description:
What buying a listed NFT with a loan (buy now, pay later) costs on
GONDI, as its Buy with Loan button quotes it: the listing, the loan
offer that finances it, the upfront payment from the buyer's wallet,
the loan's principal, APR, duration, interest and repayment at expiry,
and GONDI's Buy with Loan fee. The NFT is collateral until the loan is
repaid; unpaid at expiry, the lender takes it. When the NFT is not
listed or no offer can finance it, unavailable_reason says why. Loans
to US buyers run 28 days at most. Send
the user to gondi_url to buy. It takes a collection slug and a token
id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

name: get_buy_with_loan_quote

BuyWithLoanTerms.description: The loan that pays for the part of the price the buyer does not.

duration_days.description: At most 28 for a request from the US, where GONDI limits Buy with Loan terms to 28 days.
duration_days.title: Duration Days

interest.description: Owed at expiry on top of the principal.
interest.title: Interest

offer_expires_at.description: When the offer stops being takeable.
offer_expires_at.title: Offer Expires At

origination_fee.description: Kept by the lender out of the principal.
origination_fee.title: Origination Fee

principal.description: What the buyer borrows and repays, the origination fee included.
principal.title: Principal

repayment_at_expiry.description: The principal plus the interest of the whole duration.
repayment_at_expiry.title: Repayment At Expiry

us_duration_limit_applied.description: Whether that US limit cut the duration, interest and repayment here. It follows where the request came from, which can be the assistant's servers rather than the buyer: a buyer in the US gets the limit on GONDI either way.
us_duration_limit_applied.title: Us Duration Limit Applied

BuyWithLoanTerms.title: BuyWithLoanTerms

MarketOrder.description:
A listing or a bid: an order someone signed and that is still open.
Its amount is its price, which is what the buyer or bidder pays.

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

buyer_fee_percent.description: The GONDI fee the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays, as a percent of the price its maker set; already inside buyer_pays, never on top of it. 0 on every listing and every regular bid; only a stealth bid's publication fee (STEALTH_BID_PUBLICATION) and a BuyNowPayLaterOrder's fee fall on the bidder.
buyer_fee_percent.title: Buyer Fee Percent

buyer_pays.description: What the listing's buyer or the bid's bidder pays in total, in currency_symbol: the listed price for a listing, the bid for a bid. GONDI's seller fee comes out of the seller's proceeds, not on top of this. Buying with a loan adds its own fee (get_buy_with_loan_quote).
buyer_pays.title: Buyer Pays

gondi_fee_percent.description: The SELLER's GONDI fee when the order executes, as a percent of its price, at GONDI's current rates. It comes out of the seller's proceeds and never adds to what the buyer or bidder pays (buyer_pays). It is the sale fee (SALE), a stealth order's (STEALTH_ASK, STEALTH_BID_EXECUTION) or a sell-and-repay listing's (SELL_AND_REPAY), and 0 on CryptoPunks. It is 0 for another marketplace's order: GONDI adds nothing, and that marketplace's own fee (marketplace_fee_percent) is inside the price and comes off the seller's proceeds. Creator royalties are not included; the order does not say which of its fees they are.
gondi_fee_percent.title: Gondi Fee Percent

maker_address.description: The seller of a listing, the bidder of a bid.
maker_address.title: Maker Address

marketplace.description: Where the order or sale lives; GONDI for GONDI's own.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

marketplace_fee_percent.description: The fee the order's own marketplace (marketplace) takes from the SELLER when the order executes, as a percent of its price: GONDI's on a GONDI order (the same as gondi_fee_percent), and OpenSea's own marketplace fee on an OpenSea order, as of 2026-11, which GONDI neither sets nor receives. Null for any other marketplace, whose fee is unknown here. Name it as that marketplace's fee, never as a creator fee or royalty: a royalty is separate and not included.
marketplace_fee_percent.title: Marketplace Fee Percent

order_type.description: What the order is placed on: one NFT (SingleNFTOrder, and the SellAndRepayOrder and BuyNowPayLaterOrder listings), every NFT of the collection (CollectionOrder), those with one or several traits (TraitOrder, MultipleTraitOrder) or a chosen set of them (SetBidOrder).
order_type.title: Order Type

MarketOrder.title: MarketOrder

buy_with_loan_fee.description: That fee in the listing's currency; part of the upfront payment.
buy_with_loan_fee.title: Buy With Loan Fee

buy_with_loan_fee_percent.description: GONDI's Buy with Loan fee, as a share of the price.
buy_with_loan_fee_percent.title: Buy With Loan Fee Percent

flash_loan_fee.description: The flash-loan premium a sell-and-repay listing pays in place of the Buy with Loan fee; 0 otherwise.
flash_loan_fee.title: Flash Loan Fee

listing.description: The listing a purchase buys; null when the NFT is not for sale.

unavailable_reason.description: Why GONDI cannot finance buying it, when it cannot; null when the quote below holds.
unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason

upfront_payment.description: What the buyer pays from their wallet now, in the listing's currency: the price less what the loan lends after its origination fee, plus the Buy with Loan fee.
upfront_payment.title: Upfront Payment

upfront_payment_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
upfront_payment_usd.title: Upfront Payment Usd

title: Buy with loan quote
